decisions.item: Holder return (mainnet values, no deposit cap)
decisions.facts: formal gate median +70.6% but 5 of 16 years lose (p10 -55.3%); with the last 10 days' quieter demand the 1.96 ETH median is +0.6% (all bid) to +9.8% (all keep), below the hurdle
decisions.recommendation: small pools carry a wide loss tail (5 of 16 modeled years lose at 1.96 ETH); none lose at 20 ETH

decisions.facts: 2.6-5.4x the creator revenue of 0.03 bulk-split; higher return at 20 ETH; at 1.96 ETH 0.03 bulk-split's median is slightly higher under all-bid and observed behaviour with a milder tail
backing 0.06489617486338 ETH; keep advantage +0.0003 ETH at any assumption; keeper ceiling no longer affects listing
settlement from FWA's record; pricing gated and bounded at 32 allocation entries; while kicks are possible (exemption lifted) every open listing is checked, at most 32
decisions.residual: if FWA lifts the exemption, a kick refund is force-sent with no receipt, and FWA restores the exemption before sync, pricing counts the refund beside the position: NAV high by 0.0649 ETH per such kick until the permissionless sync
decisions.liveness_cost: with the exemption lifted and more than 32 open listings, pool pricing refuses until owner wind-down or an essential unlist brings the count to 32; with no deposit cap this is reachable from about 4 ETH of listings

decisions.checkpoint: from request charges only, at most once per 12 h: 360,000 gas + 6,000 per allocation entry or open listing read + 30,000 per FWA read at 2 gwei + one work fee
decisions.owner_key: accepted risk B3, no numeric bound (owner, 2026-11-22)
